title: gaillardia aestivalis
intro: Gaillardia aestivalis, commonly known as Indian blanket, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gaillardia aestivalis include its use in treating skin conditions, wounds, and fever, due in part to its antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
